mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_recall_batch_scope(tenant_id,batch_no) VALUES (#{tenant},#{batch}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT batch_no FROM crm_recall_batch_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_no=#{batch} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_batch_recall_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND package_id=#{packageId} AND pick_id=#{pick})
SELECT recall_id,batch_no,reason,created_by,created_at FROM crm_batch_recall WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recall_id=#{id}
SELECT recall_id,batch_no,reason,created_by,created_at FROM crm_batch_recall WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_no=#{batch} ORDER BY created_at DESC,recall_id

SELECT l.line_id,l.recall_id,l.sales_order_id,l.outbound_id,l.warehouse_id,l.seller_sku,l.batch_no,l.source_receipt_id,l.purchase_order_id,l.expected_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.quantity) FROM crm_sales_return r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.recall_line_id=l.line_id),0) AS authorized_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.received_quantity) FROM crm_sales_return r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.recall_line_id=l.line_id),0) AS received_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.confirmed_quantity) FROM crm_sales_return r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.recall_line_id=l.line_id),0) AS confirmed_quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_recall_notification n WHERE n.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND n.line_id=l.line_id) AS notification_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.quantity) FROM crm_sales_return_receipt s JOIN crm_sales_return r ON r.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND r.return_id=s.return_id WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.recall_line_id=l.line_id AND s.batch_no IS NULL AND s.identified_batch_no IS NULL),0) AS unidentified_quantity, l.close_reason,l.closed_by,l.closed_at,l.closed_expected_quantity,l.closed_received_quantity,l.closed_confirmed_quantity,l.closed_unidentified_quantity FROM crm_batch_recall_line l WHERE l.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND l.recall_id=#{recall} ORDER BY l.sales_order_id,l.outbound_id,l.line_id
SELECT recall_id FROM crm_batch_recall_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND line_id=#{line} FOR UPDATE

SELECT package_id,outbound_id,sales_order_id,warehouse_id,pick_id,sales_line_id,seller_sku,location_id,location_code,batch_no,receipt_id,purchase_order_id,quantity,shipped_at,operator_id FROM crm_batch_recall_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recall_id=#{recall} ORDER BY shipped_at,package_id,pick_id
SELECT FROM crm_recall_notification WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND notification_id=#{id}

SELECT FROM crm_recall_notification WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND line_id IN (SELECT line_id FROM crm_batch_recall_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND recall_id=#{recall}) ORDER BY notified_at,notification_id
mapper.sql: return_id,recall_id,recall_line_id,sales_order_id,outbound_id,warehouse_id,seller_sku,expected_batch_no,source_receipt_id,purchase_order_id,quantity,received_quantity,confirmed_quantity, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.quantity) FROM crm_sales_return_receipt s WHERE s.tenant_id=crm_sales_return.tenant_id AND s.return_id=crm_sales_return.return_id AND s.batch_no IS NULL AND s.identified_batch_no IS NULL),0) AS unidentified_quantity,created_by,created_at, (SELECT c.closed_at IS NOT NULL FROM crm_batch_recall_line c WHERE c.tenant_id=crm_sales_return.tenant_id AND c.line_id=crm_sales_return.recall_line_id) AS recall_closed
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_sales_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id}
SELECT recall_line_id FROM crm_sales_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id}
SELECT return_id FROM crm_sales_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM crm_sales_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY created_at DESC,return_id
SELECT FROM crm_sales_return_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND receipt_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_sales_return_receipt WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id} ORDER BY received_at,receipt_id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_sales_return SET received_quantity=received_quantity+#{quantity} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id}
UPDATE crm_sales_return_receipt SET identified_batch_no=#{batch},verified_by=#{operator},verified_at=#{at} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND receipt_id=#{id}
UPDATE crm_sales_return SET confirmed_quantity=confirmed_quantity+#{quantity} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND return_id=#{id}
